TENANT VOICE NS - FULL PROJECT ARCHIVE

VERSION
Full Archival Handover
Project Status: Active Development
Current Phase: Spring 12 - Supabase Integration

==================================================
MISSION
==================================================

Tenant Voice NS exists to answer:

"What is it actually like to live there?"

Most rental platforms focus on:
- Advertisements
- Photos
- Rent prices
- Landlord marketing

Tenant Voice NS focuses on:
- Tenant experience
- Structured review information
- Property management quality
- Long-term renter insight
- Trustworthy rental intelligence

Core philosophy:
Reliable Rental Intelligence

==================================================
PRODUCT PRINCIPLES
==================================================

1. PROPERTY FIRST

Users search for properties first.

Typical user:
"I found an apartment listing."
"Tell me about this building."

Property remains the primary object.
Landlord information appears as supporting context.

--------------------------------------------------

2. REDUCE USER FRICTION

Use:
- Autocomplete
- Dropdowns
- Clickable selections
- Predefined ranges

Avoid:
- Exact dates
- Free-text identifiers
- Users having to remember details precisely

--------------------------------------------------

3. TRUSTWORTHY DATA OVER MAXIMUM DATA

Bad data is worse than missing data.

Examples:
- N/A allowed for ratings.
- Property selection uses autocomplete.
- Category responsibilities are clearly separated.

--------------------------------------------------

4. EXPERIENCE OVER ACCUSATION

The platform collects experiences.
Not investigations.
Not legal findings.

==================================================
CORE DATA MODEL
==================================================

Landlord
    ↓
Property
    ↓
Review
    ↓
Property Ratings
Landlord Ratings

==================================================
ENTITY DEFINITIONS
==================================================

LANDLORD

Purpose:
- Property management companies
- Private landlords

Fields:
- id
- slug
- name
- type

Examples:
- Quest Property Management
- Greenwood Residential
- Private landlords

--------------------------------------------------

PROPERTY

Primary searchable object.

Fields:
- id
- slug
- name
- address
- city
- landlord_id

Examples:
- Quest Towers
- Dragon Heights
- Greenwood Towers
- Harbourview Apartments

--------------------------------------------------

REVIEW

Represents one tenant experience.

Fields:
- id
- property_id
- review_text
- occupancy_duration
- would_live_again
- created_at

==================================================
PROPERTY RATINGS
==================================================

Categories:
- cleanliness
- safety
- common_areas
- noise_levels
- parking
- amenities
- building_condition
- pet_friendliness

Reasoning:
These measure the property itself.

==================================================
LANDLORD RATINGS
==================================================

Categories:
- communication
- repair_speed
- professionalism
- lease_transparency
- move_in_experience

Reasoning:
These measure management quality.

==================================================
WHY PROPERTY AND LANDLORD RATINGS ARE SEPARATE
==================================================

Rejected:
One giant ratings system.

Problem:
Users would conflate building quality with management quality.

Example:
Building quiet.
Management unresponsive.

Solution:
Separate rating systems.

==================================================
RATING VALUES
==================================================

Allowed:
- na
- 1
- 2
- 3
- 4
- 5

Reason:
Users should not be forced to answer categories they cannot assess.

==================================================
OCCUPANCY DURATION
==================================================

Rejected:
- Move-in dates
- Move-out dates

Reason:
Users frequently do not remember accurately.

Implemented:
- Less than 1 year
- 1 to 3 years
- 4 to 6 years
- 7 to 10 years
- More than 10 years

Database values:
- less_than_1_year
- 1_to_3_years
- 4_to_6_years
- 7_to_10_years
- more_than_10_years

==================================================
SEARCH PHILOSOPHY
==================================================

Search is property-first.

Examples:
- quest → Quest Towers
- green → Greenwood Towers

Autocomplete enabled.
Clickable suggestions enabled.

Future:
Searching for a landlord should show managed properties.

==================================================
PROPERTY CREATION STRATEGY
==================================================

Rejected:
Moderator approval before posting.

Reason:
Too much friction.

Accepted:
- Search for property.
- Select property if found.
- Create/request property if not found.
- Moderate later.

Frontend:

Backend:

- Vercel

Source Control:
- GitHub

==================================================
DATABASE SCHEMA
==================================================

TABLE: landlords

Fields:
- id
- slug
- name
- type

Constraints:
- unique slug
- landlord type validation

--------------------------------------------------

TABLE: properties

Fields:
- id
- slug
- name
- address
- city
- landlord_id

Constraints:
- unique slug

Relationship:
landlord_id -> landlords.id

--------------------------------------------------

TABLE: reviews

Fields:
- id
- property_id
- review_text
- occupancy_duration
- would_live_again
- created_at

Constraints:
- occupancy duration validation
- would live again validation

--------------------------------------------------

TABLE: property_ratings

Fields:
- id
- review_id
- category
- score

Constraints:
- category validation
- score validation
- unique(review_id, category)

--------------------------------------------------

TABLE: landlord_ratings

Fields:
- id
- review_id
- category
- score

Constraints:
- category validation
- score validation
- unique(review_id, category)

==================================================
KNOWN PROJECT LORE
==================================================

The Ghost of Harbourview Past

Cause:
A legacy route:
app/properties/harbourview/page.tsx

overrode:
app/properties/[slug]/page.tsx

Lesson:
Always check for competing routes.

--------------------------------------------------

Ghost-Induced Schema Drift

Fictional threat mitigated through:
- Foreign keys
- Constraints
- Validation
- Unique indexes

--------------------------------------------------

Quest Towers

Canonically associated with:
- Haunted elevators
- Dragon-related maintenance incidents
- Questionable Dragon Defense ratings

==================================================
FINAL PHILOSOPHY
==================================================

Do not ask users for information they do not naturally know.

Examples:
- Property autocomplete
- Occupancy duration ranges
- N/A ratings
- Property-first search
- Structured rating systems

Goal:
Collect reliable rental intelligence with the least possible user friction.
